messages.subject: empty history and polygon detector
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to R and have used DENSITY in the past for secr using traps and trail cameras. However, I am trying to analyze some data from an area search for a lizard species and must use secr r for this.  So I'm using polygon detector. However it won't analyze the data and I'm getting the following:

"In make.capthist(capt, trps, fmt = fmt, noccasions = noccasions,  :
  detections with coordinates outside polygon(s) were dropped
> plot(jp)
> secr.fit(jp)
Checking data 
Session 1 
Empty histories allowed only with concurrent telemetry or sighting-only data
Error in secr.fit(jp) : 'verify' found errors in 'capthist' argument"

I'm not really sure what an empty history is. I'm using the same format that I used in DENSITY. I also ran some of the my trapping data (that I had previously used in DENSITY) and that worked fine in secr r. Not sure what the problem is. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated.

Scott

messages.subject: Re: empty history and polygon detector
parts:
Hi Murray,

Actually I just figured it out about 30 minutes ago. There were detection coordinates (lizards) that were outside of the polygon coordinates and so I guess those are listed as "empty histories".

But now I have another problem, lol. I was able to run a basic secr analyses with secr.fit but cannot do models, e.g. t or b (captures vary by time or behavior). I type in "secr.fit(jp2, model=g0-b) and it says "object g0 not found". I'm going over the users guides and can't figure this one out. I'm guessing this is a beginner mistake but then again, I'm a beginner. 

Back round on this: an arboreal lizard species (Agama family) on the southern Japan island Okinawa. They sleep on the ends of branches at night and are easy to hand capture at night. So this is a small plot ~25 by 25 meters or so on a densely forested hillside with 8 capture occasions. 51 captures and 10 recaptures.

Many thanks for the help.

Scott

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: empty history and polygon detector
parts:
Glad you made some progress...

Did you type g0-b instead of g0~b? Won't work.

Also note (i) for area search you must use one of the hazard-based detection functions 'HHN', 'HEX' etc., not 'HN', 'EX' etc. Those hazard-based functions use the intercept parameter lambda0 instead of g0, so you really want lambda0~b, (ii) if there could not physically have been more than one location per animal per occasion then the exclusive area search detector type 'polygonX' is more appropriate than 'polygon' (the horned lizard dataset of Royle and Young is an example, see ?hornedlizardCH), and (iii) 10 recaptures is really marginal, but you already knew that.

Hope this helps
Murray
